questions.stem_text:
Marginal cost (MC) is equal to average variable cost (AVC) and average total cost (ATC)
when:

options.A: MC intersects AVC and ATC at their average points.
options.B: AVC and ATC are both greater than MC.
options.C: marginal cost (MC) intersects AVC and ATC at their maximum points.
options.D: AVC and ATC are both less than MC.
options.E: AVC and ATC intersect MC at its average point.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - MC intersects AVC and ATC at their average points.

questions.stem_text: Under a pure capitalist system, would the government play a majorrole in the economy?

options.A: Government intervenes only during economic crises to stabilize the market
options.B: Government plays a minor role by enforcing contracts and property rights
options.C: No government intervention in the economy
options.D: Government provides public goods and services but does not control private enterprise
options.E: Limited government intervention primarily in defense and public safety

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - No government intervention in the economy

questions.stem_text: A competitive firm's demand for labor is determined directly by

options.A: the marginal (physical) product of labor and the output price
options.B: the opportunity cost of workers' time
options.C: the marginal (physical) product of labor and the wage

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the marginal (physical) product of labor and the output price
